column1: # KEGG module -> predicate rules (curated). Every KO in the module definition
# carries the predicates, with the module as evidence. Listed modules are
# central-carbon, fatty-acid and cofactor pathways (membership = a step of that
# pathway), respiratory/photosynthetic complexes, nitrogenase and SOX. Modules
# whose components also serve other pathways stay out (for example Hdr in
# methanogenesis, DsrAB in sulfate reduction, NarGHI in denitrification,
# AmoA/PmoA shared by nitrification and methane oxidation).
